turns.text: I ordered a custom print of the house where I grew up. It arrived Monday and I'd like to return it.

Îmi pare rău să aud că printul nu a ajuns cum v-ați dorit. Pentru a verifica comanda și politica de retur, am nevoie de numărul comenzii (SC- urmat de patru cifre) și de adresa de email cu care ați plasat-o.
That's SC-2214. The checkout email was rowan.bellwick@example.com.

Thank you, Rowan. I found order SC-2214 (The House Behind the Mulberry Gate, 50x70 cm). I'm sorry, but I can't accept a return for it. Custom commissioned work is not eligible for return under our policy, so I haven't changed anything. If the print arrived damaged or faulty, I can file a damage claim for you. Staff would then ask for a photo and decide the next step.

items.title: The House Behind the Mulberry Gate

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
